title: PPProbeCommandlet calls 2-arg ParseCommandLine which does not exist in UE 5.8 — editor module cannot compile; even arity-fixed, -seed/-ticks/-json tokens never land in Tokens
detail: Two stacked unhandled paths: (1) the 2-arg call matches no overload (only 3-arg/4-arg exist) → compile error → editor target and all engine gates fail; (2) ParseCommandLine routes dash-prefixed args into Switches with the dash stripped, so StartsWith("-seed=") over Tokens never matches.
recommended_fix: Parse into Tokens+Switches via the 3-arg UCommandlet::ParseCommandLine and iterate Switches with dash-stripped prefixes ("seed=", "ticks=", "json="); validate arity of every -key=value before use.

title: run-tests-headless.sh --probe reports "probe JSON written" and exits rc without asserting the artifact exists
detail: Path: commandlet exits 0 without writing JSON (e.g. -json silently unparsed, JsonPath empty) → script prints success and exits 0 → local-ci.sh --bless greens with the golden unchanged. Violates the repo's own artifact-assertion rule (AGENTS.md pitfall).
recommended_fix: After the run, assert the artifact: [ -f "$JSON_OUT" ] || { echo "probe JSON missing" >&2; exit 1; } — then print success.

title: compare-golden.sh's engine-vs-standalone branch is dead — nothing ever writes docs/goldens/.engine-probe.json
evidence:
if [ -f docs/goldens/.engine-probe.json ]; then
  A="docs/goldens/.engine-probe.json"

Grep over the repo: .engine-probe.json appears only at these two lines. local-ci.sh:75 gate 7 runs "scripts/run-tests-headless.sh --probe" (no --json-out); local-ci.sh:130 --bless writes --json-out docs/goldens/probe-seed42-ticks100.json directly.
detail: Even with the engine present, the gate never compares engine PPProbe output: the branch is unreachable, so gate 8 only re-checks the standalone runner against the committed golden (verified byte-identical to standalone output) — the engine numbers are never diffed.
recommended_fix: Wire gate 7 as run-tests-headless.sh --probe --json-out docs/goldens/.engine-probe.json so the engine-vs-standalone branch activates when the engine is present.

title: PPProbe accepts negative/zero -ticks and non-numeric -seed silently — reports the initial-state hash as a successful run
detail: Path: -ticks=-5 (or 0, or non-numeric → Atoi 0) skips the loop; probe prints ticks=-5 with the seeded-initial hash, logs "PPProbe RESULT=OK", exits 0. -seed=abc likewise coerces to 0 via Strtoui64. No validation guards.
recommended_fix: Reject Ticks <= 0 and unparsed seed values: log an error and return nonzero instead of reporting the un-stepped state.

title: RngRange computes Hi - Lo in int32_t before the uint32 cast — spans over INT32_MAX are signed-overflow UB
evidence:
const uint64_t Span = static_cast<uint64_t>(static_cast<uint32_t>(Hi - Lo)) + 1;
	return Lo + static_cast<int32_t>((static_cast<uint64_t>(RngNext(R)) * Span) >> 32);
detail: Path: Hi=INT32_MAX, Lo=INT32_MIN (both span-ordered per the header's contract) → Hi - Lo overflows int32_t → UB before the cast. Contract comment covers only Lo<=Hi, not span width. Latent: current callers use [6,34].
recommended_fix: Widen before subtracting: const uint64_t Span = static_cast<uint64_t>(Hi) - static_cast<uint64_t>(Lo) + 1; and document the valid span envelope.

title: Step silently swallows backward ticks — the comment's "logs via the caller" has no caller; divergence is unobservable in any state or hash
detail: Odin canon (core/step.odin:33-36) latches replay_error on backward ticks ("never silent"). Here no caller in the diff logs backward ticks and FSimState has no replay_error field — a caller bug stepping backward is indistinguishable from a no-op.
recommended_fix: Either add the replay_error latch to FSimState now (serialize it), or route the guard through a caller-visible signal before real commands land.

title: UE_ROOT discovery leg exists only in local-ci.sh — run-tests-headless.sh and install-engine.sh find_engine copies ignore it
evidence:
scripts/run-tests-headless.sh:19-24:
find_engine() {
  if [ -n "${UE_EDITOR_PATH:-}" ] && [ -x "$UE_EDITOR_PATH" ]; then
    echo "$UE_EDITOR_PATH"; return 0
  fi

scripts/local-ci.sh:43,49-50:
# Order: $UE_EDITOR_PATH -> $UE_ROOT -> the standard Epic install location.
...
  if [ -n "${UE_ROOT:-}" ]; then
    local cand="$UE_ROOT/Engine/Binaries/Mac/UnrealEditor-Cmd"
detail: Path: engine at a custom location, only UE_ROOT exported → local-ci.sh marks engine PRESENT, gates 4-7 delegate to run-tests-headless.sh which exits 127 "Unreal Engine 5.8 not found" despite local-ci's documented discovery order.
recommended_fix: Factor one shared find_engine (honoring UE_EDITOR_PATH → UE_ROOT → standard globs) and source it from all three scripts.

title: static-check.py ignores git ls-files failure — outside a git repo the CRLF scan silently scans zero files and passes
detail: Path: `git ls-files` exits 128 (e.g. exported tree without .git) → stdout empty → the loop iterates nothing → gate 3 greens with the CRLF check silently skipped. r.returncode is never checked (contrast the bash -n check at line 55 which does).
recommended_fix: check(r.returncode == 0, "git ls-files failed — CRLF scan skipped") before iterating, so degradation is loud.
